theme_archetype.reasoning: The user wants a 'Framer style' premium UI (Linear/Vercel aesthetic) replacing a cosplay Iron-Man look. Trading requires absolute data clarity (Archetype 4), while the 'Jarvis' and Framer vibe requires a cinematic, expensive feel (Archetype 5). We use 'Premium Dark Fintech'—deep obsidian backgrounds, glassmorphic cards, crisp monospace numbers, and subtle glowing accents.

fonts.monospace: JetBrains Mono, Geist Mono, or monospace

cards.classes: bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-white/90 rounded-full px-6 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 text-white hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 rounded-full px-6 py-2 text-sm transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-[#FF3366]/10 text-[#FF3366] hover:bg-[#FF3366]/20 border border-[#FF3366]/20 rounded-full px-6 py-2 text-sm transition-colors

broker_account_hero.description: The most visually arresting element showing total wealth in OANDA.

elements.title: Uses panel_title format: 'OANDA BROKER ACCOUNT'
elements.total_wealth: Uses hero_number format. Must animate with CountUp.
elements.breakdown: Row of data showing NAV vs Locked Profits.
elements.dod_change: Green/Red glowing badge showing Day-over-Day change ($ and %).

broker_account_hero.classes: relative p-8 bg-gradient-to-b from-white/[0.05] to-transparent border border-white/10 rounded-3xl

jarvis_ai_orb.location: Center of center_stage (between Broker Widget and Trading Panel)
jarvis_ai_orb.description: Premium CSS/Framer Motion orb, replacing the old cyan Iron-Man graphic.
jarvis_ai_orb.implementation: Do not use static images. Build a CSS composition: a perfectly round div (`w-48 h-48`) with `rounded-full`, multiple `box-shadow` layers for inner/outer glow, `backdrop-blur-md`, and a subtle `conic-gradient` spinning inside.
jarvis_ai_orb.motion: Breathing animation (`scale: [1, 1.02, 1]`) idle. When voice active, animate `box-shadow` audio waves.

trading_panels.description: Live Positions, Signals, and Forex Desk.
trading_panels.style: Highly dense, tabular or bento-style data.
trading_panels.typography: Use Monospace exclusively for prices, P&L, and sizing.

command_palette.description: Floating glassmorphic pill containing text input and mic toggle.
command_palette.classes: fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-full max-w-2xl bg-[#0a0a0a]/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-full p-2 flex items-center gap-2 shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]

page_load.stagger: Framer motion staggered children. Panels slide up (`y: 20`) and fade in (`opacity: 0` to `1`) with a spring transition.

numbers.counters: All broker balances and P&L must animate on load using a CountUp hook.

hover_states.cards: Subtle border highlight on hover: `hover:border-white/20 hover:bg-white/[0.04]`.

background_texture.description: Dark abstract minimalist lines. Use this as a very low opacity (10-15%) fixed background behind the app to kill the 'flat color' look.

implementation_instructions.2_fonts: Import a Grotesk (e.g., Cabinet Grotesk or Outfit), a clean Sans (e.g., Manrope), and a Monospace (e.g., JetBrains Mono). Add them to tailwind config under `font-heading`, `font-sans`, and `font-mono`.
implementation_instructions.3_globals: Update `index.css` with the deep dark theme. Set `body { background-color: #050505; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: var(--font-sans); }`
implementation_instructions.4_components: Refactor existing panels to use the 'Glassmorphic High-Contrast' card classes. Remove all old cyan (#00F0FF) borders and replace with subtle white/10 borders.
implementation_instructions.5_broker_widget: Build the new Broker Account Widget exactly as spec'd, giving it the most visual weight.
implementation_instructions.6_orb: Replace the old image-based orb with the CSS/Framer Motion orb.
